adoption_scope: Guidance and implementation defaults; not media, motion, science, platform or publication approval.

design.direction: Route by finished style: realistic video uses MoneyPrinterTurbo, 3D animation uses Blender. Effective lighting makes the subject clear and bright, with readable volume/necessary shadows and layered highlights. Background may be light or dark; retain needed shadows and black levels. Render actual exposed finishes finely, with credible structures, scientific relationships and continuous action.
design.design_board_scope: record the actual current board version/hash and reviewed scope; the bundled reference selects appearance only
design.style_reference_scope: legacy_2d_only; not approval for realistic main footage

video_generation.mixed_style: Only within explicit project scope; each segment follows its style route and records its actual production evidence.
video_generation.unavailable_tool: Report the concrete missing capability; continue independent work without silently replacing the required production project.
video_generation.evidence_boundary: Actual MoneyPrinterTurbo assembly or Blender rendering required for the selected route; names, configuration, text generation and structural checks alone do not prove execution or media quality.

audio.speaker: Serena
audio.instruct: 用平静、温和而克制的中文口语，像向身边人解释一件事情一样连续讲述。以自然陈述为主，不争辩、不鼓动，也不逐字念；保持同一个人的自然音色和音区，语速从容清楚，起音自然，句尾自然收住。提问像邀请对方观察，停顿顺着意思走，不做夸张表演。
audio.runtime_parameters: Use the confirmed project's verified runtime; local adapter examples apply only when that adapter is explicitly selected.

postprocess_example.status: deprecated_reference_only; active whole-narration defaults are in audio.mix_preset

mix_preset.scope: new_or_revised_whole_narration_master; not each visual shot; preserve valid accepted audio
mix_preset.final_mix_policy: config/production-policy.json defaults.mix; whole final encode after music/effects
mix_preset.acceptance: Measured technical result only; timbre/register/joins and final mix require actual listening; no new voice audition for unchanged preferences

captions.scale_policy: Same aspect ratio: multiply vertical values by output_height/1920, record rounding; different layout requires review.
captions.exclude: Published or already-approved-for-publication versions are not changed by this setting.
captions.move_scope: Captions and tight background only; document any necessary local label reflow.
captions.scope: legacy_portrait_revision_only; not the default for new landscape work

delivery.default_scope: Future new productions and explicitly requested landscape work only; preserve approved/published portrait identities and media.

permissions: Follow the current task, version approvals, pauses and cancellations; config adoption grants none.

platform_sync.scope: Associate the same authorized work with all connected supported publishing destinations each time, including named targets where actually available. The named list is not exhaustive; on the Douyin publishing screen enable every available platform association/sync option. Verify each separately; unavailable/unknown targets leave all-platform completion pending without undoing confirmed success. Current explicit overrides and commissioned work/account/version scope control; no automatic edits to published works.
platform_sync.named_destination_resolution: fanqie_video preserves the user-named Fanqie Video; verify actual supported destination/account identity rather than substituting another service

video_download.scope: Preserve disabled-download preference on every destination exposing a control; keep Douyin/Toutiao requirement, verify actual states, distinguish unavailable/unverified, and never auto-edit published works.

daily_counting.unpublished_inventory: not_automatically_eligible; determine new-work scope from source/version evidence

operations.scope: Historical series planning defaults; apply targets only when the current task requests this production cadence. No task or automation is created by loading this Skill.

video_monetization.scope: For each authorized work enable ordinary relevant per-video revenue/incentive controls supported by the actual account/work/program. No repeat permission per checkbox. Report ineligible/unavailable/exclusive choices or new enrollment/identity/payout prerequisites truthfully; do not infer revenue or treat unsupported rights claims and paid promotion as revenue options.

landscape_captions.policy: Design against actual scene and platform, then inspect exported text and tight backgrounds. Never scale legacy portrait Y coordinates into this layout.

shared_3d_library.storage: Versioned copies of editable used assets with dependencies, source/rights, scale/axes, preview and SHA manifest; retain project originals.
shared_3d_library.verification: Read back destination files and compare SHA before claiming archived; unavailable NAS remains local_pending_sync.
shared_3d_library.quality_boundary: Library availability is not current scientific, visual, hearing or publication approval; superseded and rejected variants are not default reusable assets.
shared_3d_library.selection_scope: Find suitable existing models, environments, materials and lighting before creating new ones; a recorded reusable status is limited to its documented scope and never automatic approval for the new film.
shared_3d_library.supporting_assets: Failed and explicitly non-default historical or diagnostic assets are not default choices; searchable using --include-supporting or --status pending/failed.

standing_authorization.policy: Use an actual recorded user grant; preserve local grants when synchronizing maintenance changes. No repeated confirmation within the granted scope.
